stats.Effect: The Convict Mercenary Captain searches for the secrets of the Cruma Tower. After listening to a bard singing a song called Seven Secrets of Cruma Tower, he has decided to officially become a knight of the king by attaining the ancient weapon, which is the third secret of the song. Since Gatekeepers of the Ivory Tower have rejected his teleport as the Convict Tribe is banned from the tower, he still has not entered the tower, but has been circling around it.
